column9: javap -public: 26 donor members, 0 with an owner member of the same contract, 8 partial analogues (README table). M3ObjectResidency is a fixed-size dense int-slot arena with a byte budget, swap/recreate and cooperative borrow handles; it has no close() (not AutoCloseable), no Disposer, no semantic remove of a pinned id, no growable sparse long-id lanes, no idle scrub/rebind pool, no count-target trim, no hit/miss Stats. The donor tests pin post-close refusal and reentrant close inside factory/rebind/scrub (2ab200c1755, 413673af79a): M3ObjectResidency has no close boundary, so no adapter can express them. LazyObjectParent: String keys, disk spill codec, Lease objects; proof of concept outside the reactor. EXTEND rejected: a MERGE would put a second storage model (sorted long ids, count trim, disposer lifecycle) into M3ObjectResidency, i.e. two owners in one file.
